# TotalFusion

> TotalFusion extends Total.js 5 with other runtimes: functions written in Python, Rust, Go and WebAssembly are called from Node.js and Total.js as `async` functions, and become actions, API routes, MCP tools for AI agents, Server-Sent Events and nodes of Flow. Each runtime is a pool of worker processes that Node.js supervises; a crash in a worker never takes the application down. A WebAssembly module runs in a sandbox: no files, no network, no environment.

Node.js 20 or newer, no dependencies, plain JavaScript (no TypeScript). Version 0.1.0, not on npm yet: install it from a clone with `npm install ../totalfusion`. The engine (`require('totalfusion')`) does not depend on Total.js; `fusion.register()`, `fusion.sse()` and `fusion.flow()` do. Nothing is downloaded, compiled or installed for the user. MIT license.

## Features

- [Binary data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/totalfusion/main/docs/binary-data.md): Buffers and typed arrays without base64
- [Streaming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/totalfusion/main/docs/streaming.md): Generators as async iterables, backpressure, cancellation
- [Working with the workers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/totalfusion/main/docs/workers.md): Concurrency, recycling, health check, events, retrying
- [Errors and cancellation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/totalfusion/main/docs/errors.md): Every error code
- [Development and diagnosis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/totalfusion/main/docs/development.md): Reload on change, and the doctor
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/totalfusion/main/docs/security.md): What it protects and what it does not
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/totalfusion/main/SECURITY.md): How to report a vulnerability, and what counts as one
